analytical_twist.model: Kirchhoff orthotropic plate, trial function w = (x - a/2)(y - b/2): strain energy depends on D66 only; Rayleigh quotient f = (1/2pi) sqrt(576 D66 / (rho h a^2 b^2)), D66 = G12 h^3 / 12; an analytical Kirchhoff reference (an upper bound only within Kirchhoff theory; NOT claimed as a strict upper bound for S4R; wording corrected in R6.7), no transverse shear (S4R includes it)

r66_controlled_g12_sensitivity.conclusion: the first torsional branch is governed by G12 (f ~ G12^0.48, shape unchanged); G12 also shifts branches 10-12 and 17-18 by up to 34 %; the G12-independent bending branches FE 8 and FE 14 stay 8-17 % above the research references, so G12 alone cannot reconcile them
r66_controlled_g12_sensitivity.proposed_next_experiment: free-free modal test of the same plate without the shaker (impact or acoustic excitation, documented soft suspension, same PSV grid); proposal only
